plugins.name: Code Theme Synchronizer
plugins.description: Harmonizes VS Code, VSCodium, and Antigravity IDE themes and colors with Hyprconf obsidian palettes and wallpaper accents.
plugins.author: shell-ninja
plugins.tagline: Live theme & obsidian palette synchronization for VS Code, VSCodium & Antigravity IDE
features: Zero-Restart Live Injection: Injects color tokens directly into running editor sessions.
Obsidian Glass Surfaces: Replaces default chrome with deep obsidian glass and subtle accent rims.
Wallpaper Harmony: Automatically synchronizes editor background, sidebar & syntax with active wallpaper.
Terminal ANSI Synchronization: Matches integrated editor terminal colors with Kitty terminal.
Safe & Non-Destructive: Automatic backup and instant restore on uninstallation.

plugins.name: Media Downloader
plugins.description: Universal video downloader and audio extractor for YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X and 1,800+ sites. Usable directly from the Dynamic Island notch and Top Bar.
plugins.author: shell-ninja
plugins.tagline: Universal video & audio grabber with live progress for Dynamic Island & Top Bar
features: 1,800+ Platform Support: YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitter/X, SoundCloud, and Vimeo.
Dynamic Island Expansion: Dedicated notch studio with live download speed, progress bar, ETA, and thumbnail preview.
Top Bar Integration: Interactive bar pill widget with live percentage display and obsidian quick-download popup.
Smart Audio Extraction: 1-click lossless MP3, M4A, or FLAC extraction with embedded metadata & cover art.
Resolution & Quality Control: Select from Best available, 1080p, 720p, or custom audio formats.
Clipboard Auto-Detection: Automatically detects copied media URLs for instant 1-click downloading.
